versions.changelog:
- Updated instructions for connecting Pingram MCP in OpenClaw, preferring chat-driven setup over command-line.
- Added guidance for users to list and choose Pingram skills to install via chat.
- Improved troubleshooting steps for MCP OAuth login issues.
- Expanded account/auth management instructions, including how to switch Pingram accounts.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

Initial release of Pingram skill for OpenClaw:

- Enables sending email and SMS via Pingram using the hosted MCP server.
- Allows management of delivery logs, phone numbers, sender domains, and account details.
- Provides clear setup instructions for connecting Pingram via MCP when not already connected.
- Includes guidance on required fields for sending messages and troubleshooting common auth issues.
- Supports regional MCP endpoints (US, Canada, EU) for flexible account integration.
